text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes… One of my classmates recommended a book to me, and it was just so engaging…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I was planning to work my way through it gradually, but before I knew it, the sun had risen…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's about an Umamusume who gets reincarnated as the princess of an enormous kingdom… I wonder what'll happen next…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion wanders off like she's in a world of her own.
